name: Aegis
verified_purpose: Typed operational-fault handling library for .NET/F#: capture, classification, redaction, recovery proposals, escalation, sinks and a GitHub event store (one immutable file per event).
maturity_observed: Implemented library; own status table claims 137 done / 4 partial / 2 not started of 143 requirements (docs/aegis/REQUIREMENTS-STATUS.md); 16 test files present, not executed by this agent; no git tags in shallow clone; consumers pin 1.0.0 while source is 2.x (per fides READINESS report).
assurance_capabilities_verified: Redaction before any sink (Secret dropped, Sensitive masked, redaction outcome observable) in src/Aegis.Core/Redaction.fs; append-refuses-overwrite immutable event files in src/Aegis.Store.GitHub/GitHubStore.fs; fingerprints, dedup, escalation policy, required-sink failure semantics, environment/revision correlation on fault events; boundary manifest aegis-boundaries.json.
assurance_gaps: Not an audit/security event log: scope is operational faults only. No hash chain, signature or external anchor over stored events. Retention enforcement out of scope (AEG-ADD-052 partial). Database adapters not built (AEG-LOG-010/037). No browser sink (per fides gap report). Store is a GitHub repo whose writers can rewrite history.
evidence_produced: Fault events with fingerprint, scope, breadcrumbs, environment and deployment/revision metadata; redaction diagnostics.
trust_boundary: In-process library; trust ends at the configured sink/store (GitHub repository permissions).
verification_basis: README; docs/aegis/README.md; docs/aegis/REQUIREMENTS-STATUS.md; src/Aegis.Core/*.fs; src/Aegis.Store.GitHub/GitHubStore.fs; tests/Aegis.Core.Tests (file inventory only)

name: Fides
verified_purpose: Common Echelon authentication/SSO boundary: GitHub App user-to-server tokens, stateless code-for-token exchange (holds client secret), PKCE, WASM client and token provider for Arca. Authentication only by owner decision DF-FIDES-2026-0010.
maturity_observed: v0.2.0 (Directory.Build.props). Own readiness report 2026-11-09: 130 requirements, 44 implemented+verified, 16 implemented-unverified, 51 missing, 12 blocked; fit for single-application pilot only; nothing deployed per CURRENT-STATE, though a Signal production config references a Fides exchange endpoint (liveness not verified). 33 test files incl. acceptance scenarios against a GitHub simulator.
assurance_capabilities_verified: PKCE, token exchange/refresh/revoke, secrets via AWS Secrets Manager port and cache (src/Fides/Secrets.fs, src/Fides.Hosting.Aws/SecretsManagerPort.fs), leak-scan tests (tests/Fides.Tests/SecretsTests.fs, ExchangeSecurityTests.fs), provider-qualified principal id FID-IDN-003, trust-boundary model tests.
assurance_gaps: Self-reported: no tenant model; known high-severity architecture violations against its own requirements (detail in fides docs, not reproduced here); provider behaviours verified only against simulator; no IR runbooks, rotation rehearsal or deployment smoke test; MFA is delegated to GitHub and not enforced or evidenced by Fides; no authorization engine (apps and GitHub repo permissions enforce).
evidence_produced: Exchange audit lines (requirement FID-SVC-004 / FID-OPS-002); Aegis faults at the exchange host. No access-review or provisioning evidence.
trust_boundary: Exchange (AWS Lambda) is the only holder of the GitHub App client secret; tokens are held in the browser; GitHub is the identity provider and the enforcement point for repository access.
verification_basis: README; context/CURRENT-STATE.md; docs/requirements/READINESS-AND-GAP-REPORT.md; docs/requirements/FIDES-REQUIREMENTS.md; src/*; tests/Fides.Tests inventory; signal/deploy/pages/signal.deployment.production.json

name: Arca
verified_purpose: Shared data layer for Echelon apps: authoritative records stored as canonical JSON in GitHub repositories; pure F# core plus GitHub adapter and Limen/IndexedDB offline queue.
maturity_observed: v0.7.0 per Directory.Build.props (fides report cites 0.7.0 on echelon-current); 27 test files incl. conformance, integrity, erasure, concurrency; CURRENT-STATE.md is stale (says no storage behaviour exists) and contradicts src/.
assurance_capabilities_verified: Content hash (sha256 of canonical bytes) and typed integrity failures incl. HashMismatch and ImmutableChanged (src/Arca.Core/Integrity.fs); one logical operation = one atomic commit with structured actor trailers (ARCA-COMMIT-001..004); explicit erasure with tombstone (src/Arca.Core/Erasure.fs, ARCA-INT-005); canonical export with per-object SHA-256 (src/Arca.Core/Export.fs); credential-shaped content refused; fail-closed write when integrity unknown (ARCA-INT-004).
assurance_gaps: No hash chain or external anchor (design only 'must not prevent' one, ARCA-INT-003); detection is relative to a hash the application previously saw, so rollback of a whole record is not detected (confirmed by Signal SEC-01 residual risk); no at-rest encryption (DF-ARCA-2026-0002); GitHub history rewrite by repo owner defeats evidence; erased content remains in Git history; tenant isolation = repository permissions only.
evidence_produced: Git commits with actor/execution/correlation trailers; content hashes; tombstones; canonical exports.
trust_boundary: Runs in the browser with the user's token; GitHub repository permissions are the access boundary; storage content treated as untrusted input.
verification_basis: README; docs/requirements/ARCA-STORAGE-REQUIREMENTS.md sections 6 and 9; src/Arca.Core/{Integrity,Erasure,Export,Commit}.fs; tests/Arca.Tests inventory; context/CURRENT-STATE.md

name: Strata

assurance_capabilities_verified: Grants, column grants and RLS policies managed and drift-compared (README table); invariants e.g. noGrantsToPublic; CI migration gate with approval exit code; read-only drift monitor; release provenance attestations.
assurance_gaps: Does not provide append-only storage, integrity verification, correction handling or tenant routing that Unbound requirements (UNB-TEC-STRATA-001..003, UNB-ACC-026) and the CCM architecture assume; untested at scale; approval via --approve flag has no recorded approver identity verified; data-interaction-virtualization requirements (STRATA-DIV-001) are proposed only.
evidence_produced: Plan/gate verdicts, drift reports (exit codes 0/1/2), release checksums and attestations.
trust_boundary: Operator-run CLI with a database connection; trust in the connection's privileges.
verification_basis: README (status, compare table, worked examples); docs/requirements/data-interaction-virtualization.md; examples/gate; src tree

name: Summa
verified_purpose: Small-business financial application: customers, invoicing, receivables, payments, double-entry ledger, periods, reports, Chrona billable-time import; books stored on GitHub through Arca. (README still describes an earlier project-administration hub.)

assurance_capabilities_verified: Balanced ledger and trial balance tests; period close blockers, adjusting/closing entries (src/Summa.Ledger/Periods.fs); reconciliation checks incl. index agreement (src/Summa.Storage/Reconciliation.fs); storage history audit flags changes to immutable records (src/Summa.Storage/Verification.fs); AES-256-GCM sealed, verified backups (src/Summa.Operations/Backup.fs); retention per record type; roster-based authorization separate from authentication; Praxis-compatible actor provenance (SUMMA-PROVENANCE.md).

trust_boundary: Browser app; GitHub repository permissions plus Summa roster; backup keys in operator key store.

name: Conditor
verified_purpose: Installer/governor that establishes a governed repository from a manifest: resolves pinned Echelon components from the Registry, installs and verifies them, writes a lock file, scaffolds CI, release and branch-protection policy.
maturity_observed: Released v0.10.29 (tag present); 9 test files (fewer than other repos, but large Conditor.Tests suite files); actively released.
assurance_capabilities_verified: ECDSA P-256 signed Registry release-attestation verification against pinned, revocable keys with no unsigned fallback (src/Conditor.Core/ReleaseAttestation.fs, trust/registry-release-keys.json); SHA-256 digest pinning of vendored packages (`conditor verify`, cited by Signal security review); branch-protection policy model incl. enforce-admins, required reviews, no force-push (BranchProtection.fs); CI-policy static check failing closed (docs/ci-policy.md); drift advisory (Drift.fs).
assurance_gaps: Does not itself evidence that branch protection stays applied after creation (continuous verification not observed); key management for the Registry signing key not reviewed; supply-chain evidence is per-install not centrally retained.
evidence_produced: Lock files, verify outputs, ci-policy JSON reports, drift advisories.
trust_boundary: Runs on developer/CI machine; trusts pinned keys and Registry digest chain.
